The old dictionary sat on his shelf.

The judge read the terms of the deal aloud.
The parties agreed, and everyone went home.

We found a good hotel in East Leeds.
The room was cheap, and the city centre was close.

He sold it to his neighbour in June.

The painter's biography was short.
